items.title: Wipro Q2 Results Preview: After TCS & HCL Tech, will this IT major exceed expectations?
items.description: Wipro is anticipated to report limited earnings growth for the September quarter due to various pressures. The focus will likely shift to guidance for the future quarter and profit margins. Analysts expect IT revenue to decline slightly despite inorganic contributions from recent acquisitions. The upcoming Q3 guidance is expected to reflect seasonality and economic conditions affecting discretionary spending. Management's commentary on deal activity will be crucial for understanding future performance.

items.title: ICICI Life Q2 net profit rises 25% on better product mix
items.description: In the latest financial report, ICICI Life Insurance announced a remarkable 25% increase in net profit for the second quarter, reaching ₹374 crore. Over the first half of FY27, profits rose by 26.5% to ₹760 crore. items.title: Hardening bond yields to weigh on bank profits in September quarter
items.description: For the September quarter, Nifty 50 banks are forecasted to see an 11.5% rise in net interest income, yet net profits are expected to grow more slowly at around 10%. This growth is supported by robust capital inflows from the RBI's FCNR-B deposit swap scheme, bolstering deposit growth. Leading banks like Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank are likely to show substantial profit growth this quarter.

items.title: BHEL Q2 Results: Net profit skyrockets 120% YoY to Rs 810 crore; revenue rises 24%
items.description: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited has announced a remarkable jump in net profit for Q2, surging 120.1% year-on-year to reach Rs 810 crore, up from Rs 368 crore last fiscal year. Additionally, revenue from operations increased by 23.8%, totaling Rs 9,300 crore. These figures showcase BHEL's strong financial performance, highlighting notable growth and operational success in this quarter.

items.title: Groww Q2 Results: Cons net profit surges 54% YoY to Rs 726 crore; revenue jumps 47%
items.description: Groww Q2 Results: The company’s revenue from operations came in at Rs 1,501 crore, marking a 47% increase from Rs 1,019 crore posted in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.

items.title: Canara Bank Q2 Results: Standalone net profit rises 8% YoY to Rs 5,175 crore, NII jumps 20%
items.description: Canara Bank has announced a standalone net profit of approximately Rs 5,175 crore for the second quarter of FY27, reflecting a growth of over 8% from the previous year. The bank also experienced a substantial increase in net interest income, surpassing Rs 11,005 crore, along with notable improvements in asset quality through a reduction in non-performing assets.

items.title: Canara Bank Q2 profit rises 8% YoY to Rs 5,175 crore
items.description: Canara Bank reported an 8.4% year-on-year rise in second-quarter net profit to Rs 5,175 crore, supported by higher net interest income and improved asset quality. Net interest income grew 20.4% to Rs 11,005 crore, while lower provisions helped earnings. Global advances rose 19.5%, outpacing deposit growth.

items.title: Bajaj Consumer Care Q2 Results: Profit jumps 66% YoY to Rs 70 crore, revenue rises 25%
items.description: Bajaj Consumer Care reported a 66% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 70.2 crore, while operating income grew 25.4% to Rs 332.8 crore. EBITDA surged 71% to Rs 83.3 crore. Domestic business revenue grew over 30%, and the company’s shares have rallied 96.42% in 2026 so far.

items.title: Tata Technologies Q2 results: Profit rises 4% YoY to Rs 171 crore; revenue jumps 28%
items.description: Tata Technologies has reported an 4% increase in profits year-on-year for the second quarter of FY27, with its operating revenue soaring 28% to Rs 1,699 crore. The net income for this quarter stood at Rs 171 crore, indicating a healthy growth. Additionally, the company announced several key deal wins, which bolster its market position.

items.title: HDB Financial Services Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 34% YoY to Rs 780 crore, revenue up 10%
items.description: HDB Financial Services Q2 Results: HDB Financial Services reported a 34% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 780 crore, while revenue from operations grew 10% to Rs 5,005 crore. The company also declared an interim dividend of Rs 2 per share. Its shares fell over 4% ahead of the earnings announcement on Wednesday.
